# Pañcasatikakkhandhaka (Kd 21)

**Section:** Khandhaka (kd)
**Collection:** Vinaya

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

During this assembly, the Buddha's personal attendant Ānanda recited the discourses, while Upāli recited the Monastic Law.

 DharmaNexus confirms this close link with DN 16, finding 114 matching Pali passages (over 14,000 shared characters; especially §1.1.2–1.1.14 aligning with DN 16 §6.19.1–6.19.11) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also detects substantial Pali text reuse in commentaries such as the *Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭṭhakathā* and the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as the succeeding *Sattasatikakkhandhaka* (Kd 22) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus identifies shared passages in the Tibetan *Vinaya-kṣudraka-vastu* (D0006-2), Sanskrit fragments of the *Mahāparinirvāṇasūtra*, and Chinese translations of the Parinirvāṇa narrative (T 1, T 6, and T 7) [DharmaNexus]. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
